bear_case: The Micron beat is a single-quarter AI hardware confirmation — it does not change the macro regime. SPX closed at 7,358, still 102 pts below the 7,460 floor; VIX unchanged at 19.49; DXY widening to 101.59. May PCE captures May data — oil's crash below $70 was a June event, and the disinflation benefit may be minimal in tomorrow's print. If PCE prints 4.1%+ YoY headline (matching consensus, confirming BofA's inflation trajectory), the 30Y immediately tests 5.00% and AI capex multiple compression returns regardless of Micron's fundamentals. TSM fell to ~$436 on June 24 despite the strong pre-earnings read from MU — institutional capital is still reducing AI hardware exposure at these levels. NVDA closed flat at $200.81 despite a constructive meeting, suggesting the market is not yet ready to pay up on AI hardware before the rate regime clears. If PCE core exceeds 3.5%, HOLD reverts to STEP ASIDE; trim newly added MU and NVDA positions within 45 minutes of the print. Invalidation: PCE core at or above 3.5% → revert to STEP ASIDE. If SPX fails to reclaim 7,460 by June 25 close even on a cool PCE print, the regime breach is structural and the framework extends BEARISH into Q3.
